title: Installation of Passenger Safety Features for Taxis and Private Hire Cars
what_it_is: Installation of Passenger Safety Features for Taxis and Private Hire Cars

sections.label: Vehicle safety devices and features
sections.summary: Taxis and private hire cars face the same safety requirements as private cars, with seat belts mandatory but airbags not, though about 70% of taxis now have airbags.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Transport whether the Ministry will consider making it mandatory for all vehicles which provide hire and reward services to be installed with safety devices and safety features to avoid incidents that compromise road safety for their passengers and road users.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: We impose the same safety requirements on taxis and private hire cars as on private cars.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Seat belts for the driver and front and back seat passengers are mandatory.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: However, we have not made airbags mandatory, as they are generally considered by the industry to be a supporting feature to supplement seat belts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: If seat belts are used properly, the injury risks to passengers are already greatly reduced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: There is no international agreement on norms on the installation of airbags.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Nevertheless, all the taxi companies in Singapore have taken the initiative to procure taxis with airbags when expanding or renewing their fleet.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Today, about 70% of all taxis in Singapore are equipped with airbags, compared to about 23% five years ago.

sections.label: Airbags in new and old cars
sections.summary: New cars usually come with airbags, but retrofitting existing cars is technically and costlier, so old cars should be phased out over time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: When operators renew or expand their fleet, new cars usually come with airbags.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: When we talk about retrofitting airbags into existing cars, then that is a different proposition as that comes with more technical and cost challenges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: We should allow time to take its natural course so that old cars in our system will eventually be phased out and all new cars will have airbags.
